entities.description: One policy per D365 entity (logical name) the app touches. Anything not listed is refused.

endpoints.description: Submit and action endpoints the app may call.

proxies.description: Outside services the app may call through the API, so their keys stay on the server (#1832).

HaikoSecurityManifest.description:
Security manifest (#1879): what the runtime API lets a signed-in contact read, create and update, and which endpoints and outside services the app may call. The runtime API enforces it (Haiko.Utils/SecurityManifest/ SecurityManifest.cs is the model it loads); this is the same shape for Studio, the Dev Kit and anything else that writes one.

Published to App Configuration as `haiko/{appId}/security-manifest`, by a person in Haiko Studio.

customerField.description: The lookup that ties a record to a contact, e.g. "customerid" or "ec_studentid". Null for shared content every contact may see.

read.description: "own": the contact's own records. "all": any signed-in contact. "none": not readable.

create.description: Whether contacts may create records of this entity.

update.description: "own": the contact may update their own records. "none": no updates.

allowedFields.description: Comma-separated fields returned to the app; omitted, empty or "*" means all. The customerField is always included when read is "own".

action.description: d365_action: the Custom API / action name.

customerField.description: The lookup set to the signed-in contact on submit.

submitMessage.description: Shown to the contact after a successful submit.

fieldMappings.description: App field name to D365 field name.

writableFields.description: The only fields a submit may carry; anything else is refused. Omitted means unrestricted, so set it.

baseUrl.description: https base URL; request paths are appended and may not leave it.

allowedPaths.description: Path prefixes allowed under baseUrl, e.g. "/find/". Omitted means any.

methods.description: GET and/or POST. Omitted means both.

secretName.description: Key Vault secret (or Proxy:Secrets:{name} setting) sent with every call.

secretHeader.description: Header the secret goes in, e.g. "api-key" or "Authorization".
